copy.title: NEON VOID
copy.lead: When the transit network died, every answer led deeper into its ruins. Survive the route and uncover what truly silenced Meridian.
copy.prologueStory: The deck wakes under the cold glow of emergency lamps. Meridian’s routes have gone silent, and a damaged buoy repeats one signal — always from the same coordinates.
copy.prologueTransmission: “If you hear this recording, do not answer. The Warden is still watching.”
copy.prologueObjective: Reach the relay first. There is no way to know whether the call is a plea for help or a lure.
copy.firstStory: The transit network fell silent. The Meridian Warden cut off the last active relay, and its distress signal repeats a single set of coordinates.
copy.firstObjective: Break the Warden blockade and reach the relay.
copy.secondStory: The Warden was not protecting the relay from you. It was guarding it from something answering on the other side. Three buoys may reveal what happened along the route.
copy.secondObjective: Recover the black boxes from all three buoys.
copy.thirdStory: The buoy warning leads to the signal core. Its shield opens only between pulses — fire in the brief windows before the relay calls again.
copy.thirdObjective: Destroy the signal core while its shield is open.
copy.fourthStory: Silencing the core brought no answer. A signal now rebounds from icy ruins far beyond the known routes.
copy.fourthObjective: Reach the Veil Archive and scan the ruins.
copy.fifthStory: The Archive revealed false coordinates. A scout near the ice shell is broadcasting them.
copy.fifthObjective: Find and disable the Veil scout.
copy.sixthStory: The scout leads to the craft steering the interference. Once it falls silent, the shipyard route should open.
copy.sixthObjective: Defeat the Null Choir and clear the route to the shipyard.
copy.completedTitle: The Shipyard at the End of the Route
copy.completedStory: The Null Choir is silent. The crew has the Meridian shipyard coordinates — rebuild the hangar and chart routes beyond the main story.
copy.hangarDetail: First reach the shipyard and recover the hangar. Free map selection stays locked until then.
copy.defeat: The last sortie ended with a lost hull. The crew is waiting for another attempt.

crew.ifTheEngineSquealsAgainIt: If the engine squeals again, it is not the engine. The old hangar is answering.
crew.iCannotPatchShieldsWithOptimism: I cannot patch shields with optimism. Bring alloy back from the next run.
crew.thereIsNoSilenceInThe: There is no silence in the void. Only signals we do not understand yet.
crew.iLeftUnnamedCoordinatesOnThe: I left unnamed coordinates on the table. Do not ask who sent them.
crew.someoneIsStillUsingTheOld: Someone is still using the old navigation marks. It could be a trail or bait.
crew.bringTheHullBackInOne: Bring the hull back in one piece. Everything else can be replaced.
crew.theTopOfTheRadarIs: The top of the radar is ahead of your nose. A long-range scanner gives you time to change course.
crew.beyondOrionTheStarsFallInto: Beyond Orion the stars fall into different patterns. Pick a destination before entering hyperspace.
crew.headlightsCheckedTheyDefaultToH: Headlights checked. They come in handy in the station’s shadow.
crew.hullCracksAreOnTheHouse: Hull cracks are on the house. Shield charging goes on the invoice.
crew.thatEngineIsAnsweringTheBuoy: That engine is answering the buoy signal again. It should not even be able to hear it.
crew.maybeSomeoneTunedItToThat: Maybe someone tuned it to that frequency before we got here.
crew.onNacreTheySayMeridianSignals: On Nacre, they say Meridian signals remember the ships that hear them.
crew.goodThenLetItRememberThis: Good. Then let it remember this ship passed my inspection.
crew.ssilDoThoseCoordinatesOnThe: Ssil, do those coordinates on the table lead beyond the known routes?
crew.theyLeadSomewhereTheChartsRefuse: They lead somewhere the charts refuse to name. That is enough for now.
crew.aBeaconWentQuietAtThe: A beacon went quiet at the edge of the system. I will fly out after my shift.
crew.checkThatYouHaveALong: Check that you have a long-range scanner before you leave.

world.glassMoonDescription: Its fractured crust reflects an old transit route. Scanners detect alloy and copper.
world.emberWorldDescription: Radioactive storms roll over its dark side. Valuable residue readings.
world.meridianWreckDescription: A former patrol craft. Its distress call cuts off halfway through a name.
world.veilArchiveDescription: Station ruins are trapped in an icy crust. The signal inside matches no known transmitter.
world.hollowCometDescription: The comet hides traces of old passages in its icy core. Sensors detect alloy and radioactive dust.
world.quietFoundryDescription: The abandoned shipyard still radiates heat. It was shut down recently, not decades ago.
world.nacreReefDescription: A field of crystals reflects courier signals. The crew may recover copper and rare residue here.
world.ashenCrownDescription: The remains of an orbital dock hang against a rust-colored atmosphere. Its navigation beacon still marks the old route.
world.paleSanctumDescription: Pale plains cover an abandoned colony’s domes. Beneath the ice, the scanner detects regular strips of old landing fields.
world.obsidianTideDescription: A dark ocean surrounds frozen islands. Brief pulses from the dormant Meridian network reflect across the night side.
world.cinderVaultDescription: Layers of dust conceal old mines. Unmarked metal airlocks remain among the craters.
world.sableGardenDescription: Green cloud bands surround a chain of research stations. Their records end on the day the routes fell silent.
world.frostThresholdDescription: Cracks in the icy crust circle an old relay. The buried port still bears the first expedition’s code.
world.rustedOrbitDescription: Dust from dry seas stains the surface orange. Freighter hulls drift above the former equator.
world.lumenBasinDescription: Turquoise vortices move through a deep atmosphere. Its buoys transmit the signature of a convoy absent from every log.
world.duskCitadelDescription: Fortification remains rise along the terminator. The last defense station repeats an empty readiness report.
world.silentMarshDescription: A network of abandoned canals crosses dark lowlands. Sensors find even rows of foundations beneath thick sediment.
world.blackLanternDescription: A lone surface tower once guided courier ships. Its identifier still appears in corrupted charts.
world.meridianReachDescription: Beyond the blue bands of the final major planet, the route vanishes from the chart. Only the Black Meridian mark remains.
world.aRemoteWorldBeyondTheOld: A remote world beyond the old routes. Scanners detect resources and traces of foreign patrols.
world.aVastWorldOnTheMeridian: A vast world on the Meridian frontier. Armed patrols circle its deposits.
